svg.title: The shallow tree earned the most in the 2026 backtest
svg.desc: Across 170 held-out stores, net was €15,000 for the baseline, €84,000 for logistic regression and €88,000 for the shallow tree. In fold 4, store 15596 scored 80% because eight of ten training stores in its reconstructed leaf succeeded. The rule would fund the store at €500 expected net, although its actual activation failed.

g.text: The shallow tree earned the most in the 2026 backtest
Each of the 170 stores was scored by a model trained on the other four folds.

g.aria-label: Three bars on a common zero-based scale, in euros
g.text: Observed outcomes, valued at the case economics

g.aria-label: An example of how the tree makes a funding decision
g.text: Its dentist-distance value was 0.105 source units.
It followed the low-distance branch twice.*
Eight of ten training stores in that leaf succeeded.
Above 60%: fund. At exactly 60%: do not fund.
This store actually failed. Use the rule to plan a pilot; a score is not a guarantee.
*Audited fold-4 reconstruction; the workbook does not specify a distance unit. Sources: held-out.csv and model-comparison.csv.
